items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I didn't know him either I just heard him on records Arthur Campbell >> [INTERVIEWEE] I wonder if Arthur used to play with Smiley and Jordan

ctx.x: He was playing the violin. He was playing the violin. Did they have a trumpet? Yeah. Well, Joe, I was gonna play on the weekend days. Um, um.

Weekends, Fridays and Saturdays, you know? But, uh, but, uh, they had Pete, Jimmy Noon, uh, Joan Veen, a fella called Arthur, he was playing the piano. Who? A fella called Arthur, he was playing the piano. He was playing the piano. He died in Chicago. He died in Chicago. He died in Chicago. And, uh, he's, I forgot who was on, who was playing the guitar. He wasn't using no banjoes. He was using guitars. stuff more louder to to you. You meet a banjo. With every banjo player you know that band can carry a tone. Much…

You know I wanted to ask you about the what you think makes for a band having a good style. What are some of the things that help it have a good style. What you mean? You hear somebody say I like the style of playing on that band.
